resources.string: A backup way to talk when the internet or the app is blocked. It chats with people nearby over Bluetooth, and works with the Bitchat app on phones. Messages hop between nearby devices, up to 7 hops. Anyone nearby can read public messages; private messages are end-to-end encrypted. It only runs while this screen is open, so it does not use battery or data otherwise.
Nearby chat is off. The app will not use Bluetooth or Nostr.
Bluetooth is not allowed yet. Press Allow Bluetooth to chat with people nearby.
Bluetooth permission was not given. You can still use the area chat over the internet.
On this Android version, finding Bluetooth devices needs the Location permission and Location turned on. Your location is not read or sent.
This device has no Bluetooth LE. Only the area chat over the internet can be used.
Bluetooth is off. Turn it on in the TV settings.
Others cannot find this TV over Bluetooth (its Bluetooth chip can\'t broadcast), but it can still connect to phones nearby.
Area chat (internet): off. Pick an area to use it.

Bitchat location channels use a geohash, such as u3qc for a city or u3qcn for a district. Leave it empty to turn the internet chat off. Only the area chat uses the internet, through the public Nostr relays below.
That is not a geohash. Use letters and digits like u3qcn.
